# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 100 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 100 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_100_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 17

**1** "Now, Lord," I said, "explain the virgins to me as well." "Do you not understand who the virgins are?" he asked. **2** "No, Lord," I answered. "These twelve virgins," he said, "are spirits. **3** But why are they not all called by the same name? Listen. **4** The four corner virgins are the more powerful among them and also take the lead over the rest — **5** because whoever bears their names shall enter the kingdom of God. **6** But the names of the weaker ones who stand between them — **7** whoever bears the names of these and also of those who lead them shall likewise enter the kingdom of God." **8** "Do the virgins then have power?" I asked. **9** "Yes, they possess power," he said. "In fact, all these holy spirits have power, and those who bear their names cannot act otherwise than in accordance with those spirits. **10** But now see who the women are that are clothed in the black garments." **11** "These also," he said, "are twelve in number, sisters of these virgins. Their names are: Unbelief, Intemperance, Disobedience, Deceit, Sorrow, Wickedness, Licentiousness, Bitterness, Lying, and Hatred. **12** Whoever among the servants of God bears these names shall not enter the kingdom of God, but shall be cast out." **13** "But the stones that were rejected and not fitted into the tower — who are they?" **14** "These are the dry ones," he said, "those who bear the names of the wicked women. They cannot be fitted in because they are rough and covered with marks left by the wicked women."

---

*LOGOS: the power of bearing a name = the power of being shaped by that reality. The twelve vices are literal spiritual forces that deform the soul.*
